_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Create a new account
operations.description: The integration sends a request to this endpoint to create a corresponding account in Pleo for any new record created in the external ERP/accounting system. The request fails if any similar accounts with the same `externalId` and `companyId` already exists in Pleo.

operations.name: Delete an account
operations.description: Deletes an existing account in Pleo. Only accounts not linked to any accounting entries can be deleted. Trying to delete an account linked to accounting entries will result in an error. If an account is linked, it can be archived instead. Use UPDATE endpoint to archive an account.

accountId.description: ID of the account to delete.

operations.name: Retrieves an account in pleo by its id
operations.description: Search for a specific account by its account ID.

accountId.description: ID of the account to retrieve.

operations.name: Fetch a list of accounts
operations.description: Retrieves a list of accounts with optional filters for companyId, ids, name, code and archived status. Results are paginated.

before.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset])

after.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset])

offset.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after])

limit.description: The maximum amount of items to return

sorting_keys.description: The keys to sort the results by

sorting_order.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key

operations.name: Update an account
operations.description: Update details of an existing account in Pleo. The integration must send a request to this endpoint when it is trying to archive an account linked to accounting entries.

accountId.description: ID of the account to update.
